decisions.reason: This Requirement already contains a complete same-message MODIFY establishing the 6 x 9 inch trim size.
Selecting the trim size does not change the requested guidance about publication processes, front matter, back matter, or other prerequisites.
The 6 x 9 inch trim-size decision does not alter the required back matter or author lines.
The trim-size decision does not change the copyright-page publication attribution.
The selected book dimensions do not change the specified Chapter 18 subtitle role or heading-consistency rules.
The trim-size selection does not change the existing requirements to preserve image aspect ratio and avoid unintended cropping; no replacement image dimensions are specified.
The existing rule to update table-of-contents page numbers after fixing the book size remains valid unchanged; the source does not modify that rule or report the pagination update.
The paperback trim size does not change the manuscript copyediting, sentence-clarity, or meaning-preservation requirements.
The source Event establishes only the trim size. The same message merely says full-page image placement is being considered and does not authoritatively modify the existing placement requirement.
The trim-size decision does not change the authoritative manuscript file, accepted passages, tracked edits, or table-text content.
